newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 21.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 44.95 points to 6,703.55, as blue chips staged a late rally.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended a holiday-shortened week on an upbeat note, rising 16.80 points to 1,104.58. But analysts said players were still nervous after the market experienced sharp falls earlier in the week.
* Tenaga Nasional is to start a roadshow this week for its upcoming $400 million Yankee bond issue, said bankers in Hong Kong. Tenaga officials could not be immediately reached.

* Malaysia and United States agreed on an "open skies" treaty liberalising air travel between the countries, said Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik on Sunday. Malaysian Airlines System Bhd currently has flights to Los Angeles.

* "The market should be mixed to higher this week, as the Dow gained quite a bit last week, so we would be playing catch-up with it. Blue chips and banking stocks should gain the most this week, as they had dropped the most," said Soh Meng Hui, research manager at K.L. City Securities.
* The Composite Index could test the 1,170 level, said Jasmine Yim, chartist at Vickers Ballas in Singapore.
